origin.description: Count lines, non-empty lines, characters, and non-white characters.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A character vector. Each element is one line.

origin.details: White space is the Unicode White_Space property. A missing string is skipped. A newline inside a string is an error.
origin.value: A named integer vector: Lines, LinesNEmpty, Chars, CharsNWhite.
origin.example: s <- c("Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipisicing elit.", "nibh augue, suscipit a, scelerisque sed, lacinia in, mi.", "Cras vel lorem. Etiam pellentesque aliquet tellus.", ""); x <- stri_stats_general(s); cat(paste0("stri_stats_general(s)$Lines returns ", x["Lines"], " and Chars returns ", x["Chars"], ".\n"))

translation.description: Count lines, non-empty lines, characters, and non-white characters.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings. Each element is one line.

translation.details: White space uses ICU's White_Space property. NA is skipped. The string "NA" is counted. A newline code point raises ValueError.
translation.value: A dict with Lines, LinesNEmpty, Chars, and CharsNWhite.
translation.example:
s = ["Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipisicing elit.", "nibh augue, suscipit a, scelerisque sed, lacinia in, mi.", "Cras vel lorem. Etiam pellentesque aliquet tellus.", ""]
x = stri_stats_general(s)
print(f"stri_stats_general(s)['Lines'] returns {x['Lines']} and Chars returns {x['Chars']}.")
